assertions.description: Regenerating contracts/ produces byte-identical output. Nothing is hand-edited.

No kind may declare simulated:true without citing at least one executable spec that exists on disk, and every mutating tool contract must declare REVISION_STALE. This is the load-bearing honesty check (invariants I2 and I6).
contracts/capability.json must declare at least one unsupported entry with a specific required_to_support. An empty unsupported array is a claim that nothing is missing, and is a failure.
Every tool name in backend/agent/schemas.py has a matching contracts/tools/<name>.tool.json.
telemetry.schema.json declares the four quality values and forces value=null when quality is unavailable. Invariant I5.
Every compatible_with entry names a declared port type, and every kind port uses a declared type. Invariant I7.
